drbd-reactorctl-edit 
Edit/Add a plugin configuration

USAGE:
    drbd-reactorctl edit [FLAGS] [OPTIONS] [--] [configs]...

FLAGS:
        --disabled    Edit a disabled file
    -f, --force       Force dangerous edits
    -h, --help        Prints help information

OPTIONS:
        --context <context>    Uses the given (cluster) context [default: default]
        --nodes <nodes>...     Uses only the given nodes from the context [default: ]
    -t, --type <type>          Plugin type [default: promoter]  [possible values: promoter, prometheus, agentx, umh,
                               debugger]

ARGS:
    <configs>...    Configs to edit/add
